label: rem:fermionic-twisted-sectors
title: Fermionic sectors as twisted sectors
html:
Remark. Fermionic sectors as twisted sectors

A non-vanishing obstruction class \kappa_n obstructs the lift \mathcal{S}_n \to \mathcal{S}_{n+1}. The transition between brane levels acquires a non-trivial twist. Under the algebraic filter, fermionic-type matter (the q-harmonic forms satisfying [F_A, \alpha] \neq 0) exists precisely at the loci where \kappa_n \neq 0. This obstruction class creates "twisted" sectors in the gauge flow. The holonomy around these sectors acquires a phase in H^2(M, \mathcal{O}_M^{\times}) that prevents the vortex filament from lifting smoothly. This forces the localisation of fermionic excitations at the monodromy fixed points of the brane tower.
